title: Thursday Daily Practice
subtitle: Class P2 warm-up: recall the new words and read your yoghurt answer aloud
theme: Trial Lesson 2 · Warm-up for class P2
source: DailyPractice_Trial2_Student.pdf / DailyPractice_Trial2_Teacher.pdf (Pre-IELTS Trial Lesson 2, Daily Practice), Thursday 5/11 (class day P2)
intro: P2 class from 19:30 to 21:30. Warm up with 2 steps only, 15 minutes; bring a pen and notes to class. Deadline 23:30 the same day: complete and on time earns 10 Meow (class); late or half done earns 5 Meow. Do not look at the answers before you finish.

steps.title: Step 1 · Vocabulary recall
steps.instructions: Fill in the words or phrases from the box (hectic · commute · keep up with · a sense of achievement · procrastinate). Change the word form if needed.

items.label: Exam week is always ____: I have three tests in two days.
I read English news every morning to ____ what happens in the world.
Finishing my first 150-word essay gave me ____.
My ____ is short because I live near the campus.
He often ____ until the night before the deadline.
items.explain: Chủ ngữ He + hiện tại đơn: thêm -s.

steps.title: Step 2 · Speaking warm-up and voice note
steps.instructions: Say aloud 10 new words, each with an example of your own, then say aloud your error log from Tuesday. Then read aloud your yoghurt piece from Monday, once. Record 1 voice note.
lines: 1. Nói 10 từ mới, mỗi từ một ví dụ (hectic, commute, keep up with, a sense of achievement, juggle, be packed with, unwind, productive, procrastinate, prioritise).
2. Nói lại error log thứ 3: câu sai và 'Next time I will ...'.
3. Đọc to bài yoghurt của thứ 2, một lần.
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét phát âm, đuôi -ed và nhịp đọc.

send_today: Hoàn thành 2 bước trên web. Voice note ở Step 2 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
